description:
A fast, beautiful MongoDB GUI for developers


Monghoul 1.12.1
This release fixes one defect in 1.12.0. A connection can be told not to save query results, and
in 1.12.0 that setting also emptied the result panel: the query ran, the row count and the timings
arrived, and the documents were nowhere. They are shown again now, for as long as the app is open,
and they still never reach the local database. Nothing else changed, so update only if you use that
setting or mean to.
Fixed
Query and Results
- Results show even when they are not saved — Turning "Save query results" off emptied the result panel on every run, not only after a restart. The rows are shown while the app is open, and still never saved.
